proposed_source_policy: Project-maintained local_core includes independently authored vocabulary and reference-derived words/name/title lists contributed in batches 012 through 015. Those batches are attributed separately with immutable contribution commits and the known source sites; exact page/revision manifests were not supplied. Their source-site content and trademarks are not relicensed by the project's MIT code license. Project-generated pinyin and relative ranking weights are editorial data, not scraped internet/search/corpus frequencies. No third-party bulk Rime, Sogou, Baidu, Microsoft, Google, or public GitHub candidate dictionary was imported into local_core. The separate standard_zh_pinyin.tsv layer contains licensed Rime/AOSP vocabulary recorded in sources/lexicon_sources.json and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. Pypinyin is an authoring-only pronunciation checker and is not bundled. The earlier pronunciation_review dated 2026-10-12 does not claim formal linguistic review of the remote 2026-10-14 batches.
